lines.text: バナナの木は、実は木じゃないって知ってた？
prompts: a giant green tropical plant with huge wide leaves in a sunny garden, storybook illustration
a tall leafy tropical plant under a bright blue sky, storybook illustration

lines.text: 植物学では、草の仲間とされているんだ。
prompts: a small green meadow with tall grass swaying in the wind, storybook illustration
a gardener adult man looking up at a giant leafy plant, storybook illustration

lines.text: 幹のように見える部分は、実は葉の根元が重なったものなんだよ。
prompts: close view of many layers of green leaf bases wrapped around each other like a smooth green pillar, storybook illustration
a large green leaf unrolling slowly in soft morning light

lines.text: 本物の木のような、硬い幹は持っていないんだ。
prompts: a thick old oak tree with rough brown bark in a forest, storybook illustration
a soft green plant stem cut open showing watery layers, storybook illustration

lines.text: それでも背丈は数メートルにもなる、世界最大級の草だと言われているよ。
prompts: a very tall green plant towering over a small wooden hut in a tropical village, storybook illustration
a small bird perched on a huge green leaf in a tropical garden

lines.text: 見た目だけでは分からない、不思議な植物だね。
prompts: a misty tropical garden at sunrise with giant leaves, storybook illustration

lines.text: フォローして、次の雑学も受け取ってね！
prompts: a friendly glowing lantern on a wooden table with an old storybook, storybook illustration
